obligations.expected_behavior: A fresh checkout with the pinned inputs reproduces the terminal semantic verdict.
forbidden_result: A fresh checkout produces a terminal semantic verdict that differs from the verdict determined by the pinned inputs.
A terminal semantic verdict is accepted without reproduction from a fresh checkout and pinned inputs.
obligations.observable_result: Attributable replay evidence from a fresh checkout shows the reproduced terminal semantic verdict matches the pinned-input semantic verdict.
obligations.state_after: The fresh-checkout replay has reproduced the terminal semantic verdict from the pinned inputs.
obligations.state_before: A fresh checkout has the pinned inputs but has not yet reproduced the terminal semantic verdict.
obligations.subject: Fresh-checkout semantic replay
obligations.trigger: An operator runs semantic replay from a fresh checkout with pinned inputs.
